title: The digest tells tests.py's empty-selection refusal from a pytest exit 2 by a flag on the row, not by exit and selected
goal: tests.py's refusal of a selection that collects nothing marks its test.run row with its own flag (a closed key of ql_capture's test.run schema), and ql_report.ops_lines counts that flag and the legacy exit 5 as selected nothing, so a pytest exit 2 from a collection error or an interrupted run (junit files empty, selected 0) counts as failed again. Found by the SP-evkj4avq review in _tools/ql_report.py ops_lines after BG-rqkc66vj.
